official_sources.title: Git hash-object working-tree blob calculation
official_sources.finding: git hash-object computes the object name for file content while applying path-dependent filters, supporting exact checked-out script verification.

official_sources.title: Git cat-file object existence and type
official_sources.finding: git cat-file -e verifies that an object exists and object type syntax can require a blob before execution.

official_sources.title: Git status porcelain v1 stability
official_sources.finding: Porcelain v1 is designed as a stable machine-readable status format independent of user configuration.

official_sources.title: Git update-ref compare-and-swap
official_sources.finding: Supplying the old object ID makes a ref update conditional on the current value, preventing concurrent branch work from being overwritten.

official_sources.title: Python disk_usage free-byte measurement
official_sources.finding: shutil.disk_usage returns total, used and free byte counts for the filesystem containing the path.

official_sources.title: Python subprocess timeout cleanup
official_sources.finding: TimeoutExpired is raised on bounded waits and the child must be killed and communication completed for proper cleanup.

official_sources.title: Python strict JSON decoder hooks
official_sources.finding: object_pairs_hook supports duplicate-name detection and parse_constant can reject NaN and infinities; allow_nan false rejects non-standard output.

official_sources.title: GitHub contents update concurrency contract
official_sources.finding: Updating an existing file requires its blob SHA and concurrent content operations can conflict, so serial compare-and-update writes remain fail-closed.
